results.title: Databricks launches new always-on Genie, an AI agent for enterprise work
results.content:
At the Data + AI Live event on November 11, Ali Ghodsi presented the new Genie and talked about frontier intelligence in business with Greg Brockman of OpenAI. The event is also available on video.

Video · YouTubeDATA + AI LIVE: Context Is Just the BeginningClicking loads the YouTube player, which may set cookies. Privacy Policy · Open on YouTube

## A race to put AI into office work [...] Databricks is a San Francisco company that sells a platform where a business brings its data (tables, documents, logs) together to build analytics and artificial intelligence applications on top, with pay-as-you-go pricing. In its press release the company says it serves more than 20,000 organizations, Mastercard and Unilever among them. Genie has been the platform's assistant since 2024. Until now it answered questions about data in natural language, with SQL queries and visualizations. [...] For now the new Genie is more announced than available. Genie and Genie Ontology, the layer that teaches it how the business works, are already open to all customers. The always-on agent, Genie Search and the Ontology Manager tool are coming soon in preview and beta programs. The press release gives no dates.

 Databricks Genie, the new always-on AI agent for enterprise work: a goal, sub-agents and a decision handed back to the person

results.title: Databricks unveils second-generation Genie with autonomous | VARINDIA
results.content:
Databricks’ second-generation Genie adds autonomous workflows, enterprise search and expanded business context tools, with governance controls for agent actions. The new always-on capabilities, Genie Search and Ontology Manager will enter preview and beta programs soon.

Databricks has announced the second generation of Genie, introducing an always-on autonomous agent designed to manage enterprise tasks, coordinate subagents and seek human input when decisions are required. [...] The new capabilities will allow employees to assign goals and boundaries, with Genie tracking progress, following up on missing inputs and highlighting work requiring attention. The announcement also includes Genie Search, expanded business context management and additional integrations with enterprise applications.

Genie and Genie Ontology are generally available. The new always-on Genie, Genie Search and Ontology Manager are coming soon to preview and beta programs. [...] Databricks said it now offers more than 100 connectors supporting data ingestion, in-place indexing and live application queries through Model Context Protocol (MCP). Supported tools include Google Drive, Jira and Confluence.

results.title: Databricks turns Genie into always-on agent for complex work | TechTarget
results.content:
Since its introduction in June 2024, Databricks has continuously expanded Genie to include Genie One for natural language-based data analysis, Genie Agents to help users develop domain-specific agents built on reasoning from curated datasets and business logic, Genie Code to help data engineers and scientists write and debug code for building pipelines, and Genie Ontology.

Now, Databricks is expanding Genie to include Search and make Genie agents more autonomous. [...] "Every major data platform and hyperscaler is converging on the same pattern: a semantic or context layer, unified search across structured and unstructured data, and agents that act on both," Mohan said.

While Mohan highlighted Genie Ontology, Leone tabbed Genie Search as perhaps the most valuable of Databricks' new features because it unifies searches across entire data estates so that agents no longer have to run individual searches for each data source. [...] Eric Avidon's headshot

message.content:
# Briefing: Databricks Meeting
**Date & Time:** November 20, 2026 at 10:00 AM (+05:30)  

## Recent developments
* **EMEA Expansion Strategy:** Databricks announced plans to invest approximately $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East by 2029 to address heavy enterprise demand for AI deployment. This includes a newly committed $500 million investment in the Netherlands through 2029, with plans to grow regional headcount by roughly 50% over the next three years [1].
* **Second-Generation Genie Launch:** At the Data + AI Live event on November 11, 2026, CEO Ali Ghodsi (alongside OpenAI’s Greg Brockman) unveiled the second generation of Genie, turning the tool into an always-on autonomous enterprise AI agent [2, 4]. 
* **New Genie Features & Integrations:** The upgraded platform introduces Genie Search, Ontology Manager, and support for over 100 connectors using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to ingest and query data from tools like Google Drive, Jira, and Confluence [2, 4]. While Genie and Genie Ontology are generally available, the always-on agent, Genie Search, and Ontology Manager are scheduled for upcoming preview and beta releases [2, 4].

## Talking points
* **Autonomous AI Agents:** Discuss how the second-generation Genie and its subagent workflows can streamline automated task coordination, decision-making checkpoints, and enterprise-wide data ingestion for our teams.
* **Semantic Context & Integration:** Inquire about best practices for leveraging Genie Ontology and the new MCP connectors (Google Drive, Jira, Confluence) to unify structured and unstructured data estates.
* **Regional Infrastructure & Scaling:** If expanding operations in EMEA, explore how Databricks' newly announced $3 billion regional investment and local data center/headcount growth could benefit our cross-border compliance and workload performance.

## Open questions
* What is the exact rollout timeline (preview/beta vs. general availability) for the new always-on Genie agent and Ontology Manager?
* How does Databricks price and govern the resource consumption of always-on autonomous subagents compared to traditional pay-as-you-go data queries?
* What specific data governance controls and guardrails are enforced when Genie coordinates across external third-party applications via MCP connectors?

## Sources
* [1] [Databricks plans $3bn expansion in Europe and the Middle East](https://www.fdiintelligence.com/content/5bb124fa-eadd-401f-b53e-290105c09663)
* [2] [Databricks launches new always-on Genie, an AI agent for enterprise work](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/32632/databricks-always-on-genie-ai-agent)
* [3] [Databricks IPO: Is Databricks Public? Status and Valuation](https://admiralmarkets.com/education/articles/shares/databricks-ipo)
* [4] [Databricks unveils second-generation Genie with autonomous | VARINDIA](https://www.varindia.com/news/databricks-unveils-second-generation-genie-with-autonomous-enterprise-workflows)
* [5] [Databricks turns Genie into always-on agent for complex work | TechTarget](https://www.techtarget.com/news/databricks-turns-genie-into-always-on-agent-for-complex-work/874354)
